set.st: Henry W. Onnen, a Minonk recluse who distrusted banks and courts, was found dead in October 1941. A note behind his calendar told three nephews to dig under the henhouse 'all at once'; they found fruit jars, tins and a sealed inner tube of money and jewellery (accounts give from about $2,300 to $10,000). In 1942 his sister sued, saying an old coin collection once appraised by a Woodford County bank at $20,000 was not found in the digging; the court left open whether there was 'yet to be more digging'. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: The henhouse cache was dug; the coin collection was never reported found (papers sampled to 1950). Place Onnen's home near Minonk on a 1940s Woodford plat. Access: private.
src: Woodford County Journal 8 Oct 1942 p1 'Buried Treasure Suit' (Newspapers.com 1041676264, PC read)
